prompts.name: 四器材-异种电极等势线
prompts.tank: TANK: image 3 is actual dipole measurement reference. Two small metal post electrodes on back-front midline (no parallel strips, no ring electrode). FIVE yellow hollow markers on upper U arc toward tank center from upper electrode; FIVE red markers on straight middle bisector; FIVE blue markers on lower inverted-U arc toward tank center from lower electrode. Preserve these shapes and symmetry from photo. Join same-color markers with one THIN matching yellow/red/blue line, exactly three nonintersecting equipotential guide lines as in supplied reference. These are planar graphic guide lines at the bottom of the tank, not raised wires or glowing tubes. Do not close curves into circles, do not connect different colors, do not draw arrows or voltage labels. All three guide lines stay within the tank. Keep tank viewpoint nearly overhead for readability.

final_prompt:
Refine this selected cover image by CHANGING COMPOSITION AND SCALE ONLY. Preserve exact typography: 把物理 / 做出来, AI与实验的协同教学, 丁龙 黄灿斌 / 王硕 严力耕, 深圳市育才一中. Preserve FOUR apparatus and their arrangement, same paper-collage palette. The current tall elevator rail crowds the text; fix decisively.

Text occupies upper 45 percent. Below the school name leave a clean uninterrupted CREAM whitespace band at least 5% of canvas height. NO apparatus or colored paper may intrude into this band or title/author text region.
Entire scientific still life starts BELOW 53% of image height. Scale the overweight/weightlessness black elevator apparatus DOWN to about 55% of its current height, and place it in UPPER LEFT of the illustration area, fully below the text. Keep its tall-thin proportions and triangular base; do not shorten the physical rail relative to its base. Scale shallow water tank to 78% current width and place it UPPER RIGHT of illustration area. Lower row: induction CD and red coil BOTTOM LEFT, two magnetic circuit tiles BOTTOM RIGHT, reduce slightly as needed. Use clear generous gaps between the four groups, no overlap. Outer margins at least 6%. Do not let the elevator extend down into induction group. The illustration is a calm 2x2 arrangement, not a collage pile. Maintain tactile torn-paper waves but fewer large quieter shapes, ample ivory background visible between objects.

Preserve water tank EXACTLY: two point electrodes, FIVE yellow rings with thin yellow U curve on back side, FIVE red rings on thin straight red bisector, FIVE blue rings with thin inverted-U blue curve on front side. Lines stay within water tank and never cross. No straight electrode strips. Preserve the four red coil terminals. Every circuit tile has its own integrated side contacts, no separate magnetic bar. No decorative red connector or extra labels. IMPORTANT make the two upper apparatus visibly SMALLER and give the cover a spacious, uncluttered book-design balance.
